title: Chapter 417: Homecoming
content:
Chapter 417: Homecoming

"Who do you guys listen to?!"

The black dog mask said with a gloomy voice.

The Cat Cat Mask didn't say anything, but his anger had already shown everything.

At this time, the two Huangwei and two members of the Gen Organization said in unison: "Sorry, our first obedience will always be the City Lord and Miss Lu Xue."

Whether it is Awei or An Xing, when cultivating his subordinates, he will always tell the other party that the first person to obey is not himself, but the city lord and Miss Lu Xue.

"Take it down."

At this time, Lu Xue in the distance waved her hand and then continued to head towards the city lord's mansion.

"Yes, Miss Lu Xue."

When everyone around saw this scene, they all looked at each other speechlessly.

It is worthy of being Miss Lu Xue, and she still says the same thing in the deserted city.

"Miss Lu Xue, please stay."

At this time, an old voice came from behind.

Hearing this familiar voice, Lu Xue smiled and turned slowly.

"Three seniors, long time no see."

The three of them were dressed in different clothes, but they were all older people appeared in Lu Xue's vision.

And everyone around had already looked respectful.

These three people are the ancestors of the three major tribes in Huangcheng.

Rumor has it that these three people have a close relationship with the city lord and often sit together to discuss it.

"Xiaoxue, after years of separation, you are so old."

The ancestor of the Zhang family looked at Lu Xue, who was now graceful and graceful, and his face showed emotion.

Looking back at the time, Lu Xue was just a little baby who often ran to his house to ask for snacks.

The ancestor of the Li family on the side laughed and said, "Old Zhang, don't exaggerate it. Xiaoxue has long been like this, okay, but,

The ancestor of the Li family restrained his smile and sighed slightly, "Xiaoxue's personality has changed a lot."

The ancestor of the Liu family also nodded and agreed, "Yes, this will happen if you experience it too much."

Listening to the three old men, Lu Xue was very tactful and did not interrupt. Until the three of them finished speaking, Lu Xue smiled and said, "Three seniors, don't you want to talk to the city lord's mansion?"

Hearing this, the three of them looked at each other and laughed, "Then it's better to obey your orders than respect."

Afterwards, the four of them left with each other.

At this time, in a tavern in the deserted city.

Several guests were squinting their eyes and enjoying the fine wine in their hands. The reason for the few people in the store was not because the wine was not good, but because it was too expensive, and few people in the city could afford it.

And the place here is remote, and people who can afford it will not come here to drink.

Many people say that the owner of this tavern is not trying to make money at all.

Some people also say that the owner of this tavern is a psychopath.

Everyone has different opinions, but no one has ever dared to come here to cause trouble.

On this day, an old man dressed in a cloth robes and a broken sword walked slowly into the tavern.

The people around him immediately opened their eyes and looked at the old man.

When I saw the old man in my face, I recalled the memories in my mind for a long time, and they shook their heads and continued to taste the wine.

At this time, a young woman walked over and said politely to the old man: "This old senior, don't you know what you want to drink?"

Hearing this, the old man looked at the order in his hand, frowned, thought for a moment, and asked for the cheapest cup.

"Okay, senior, please wait."

In just a moment, a glass of wine that cannot be smaller was brought to the old man.

Seeing this small glass of wine, the old man twitched slightly and smiled.

He muttered, "It's worthy of being you, you're still so stingy."

In this way, with a glass of wine, the old man drank from daytime to night until the tavern was about to close.

Seeing the old man still sitting there, sucking the small wine with a little left, the young woman couldn't help but step forward and said, "Senior, our tavern is about to close."

Hearing this, the old man finished the last bit of wine in one sip, and then threw the wine glass on the table.

Bang!

A crisp sound.

"What kind of broken wine are you? Ask your boss to come!"

The young woman frowned slightly and couldn't help but say, "Senior, my tavern has no grudges and grudges against you, why do you do this?"

The old man chuckled, "Not so many things, I'll ask your boss to come."

What else does the young woman want to say.

At this moment, a rough voice came from behind.

"Xiaoyu, go back, I'll do it."

When the young woman named Xiaoyu heard this, she turned around and complained to the figure behind her, "Dad, this person is looking for trouble."

But when she saw her father smiling, she was stunned again.

At this time, Xiaoyu's father was smiling at the old man.

"You guys, know each other?"

The old man Broken Sword chuckled and said, "Old Man Drunk, I haven't seen you for many years, so you still look like this."

Xiaoyu's father, the drunk old man.

Hearing the old man Broken Sword's words, the expression on the old man Zui's face was also very exciting.

"You guy, I should say this."

......

"What did you say? That guy Shi Tianzhi stayed in the Tianxuan World?"

The old man Broken Sword said in disbelief.

Hearing this, the drunk old man took a sip of wine and sighed, "Yes, since you left, that guy Shi Tianzhi has also left."

"But it's different from your wandering around the world. He chose to return home, and I don't know how he is now."

The drunk old man stared at the wine glass in his hand, and his thoughts returned to a long time ago.

"When you are old, do you really want to go back?"

In the deserted city, the old man drunk looked at Shi Tianzhi, who seemed to have decided to leave, suppressed his reluctance and continued to ask.

Shi Tianzhi turned his back to the old man Zui, looked at the bustling streets of the deserted city outside the window, and chuckled: "Everyone has a different choice. You choose to stay here to develop with peace of mind. The broken sword chooses to explore the world, and I choose to return home."

"Don't worry, we will meet again one day in the future."

Looking at Shi Tianzhi at this moment, the old man Zui couldn't help but say, "Old Shi, I don't understand, isn't the wasteland city good? Now you have seen a wider world, why do you still choose to go back, even if it has developed there. It's getting up, but it's still far behind here."

Faced with the old man Zui’s incomprehension, Shi Tianzhi whispered: “Where is home.”

The drunk old man was silent.

In the end, Shi Tianzhi left and returned to the Tianxuan World.

Since then, Old Man Zui has never seen him again.

"Oh, that's how it is. Tell me one by one. At least we were the best in the Tianxuan world back then, and our personalities were so weird."

The drunk old man became more annoyed the more he talked about it. The main reason was that he drank wine every day and had no wine.

"Okay, okay, you have the nerve to talk to us, tell me first, what's wrong with Xiaoyu?"

As he said that, the old man Broken Sword pointed at Xiaoyu who was respectful.

I have been talking about the past just now, but now the old man Broken Sword remembered this and hurriedly looked at the old man Zui.

"You said Xiaoyu, I adopted him outside, so I raised him as my daughter."

The old man drunk said it directly without caring about it.

Xiaoyu lowered her head slightly. It was obvious that she had known about her affairs for a long time.
